title: Swap two slots
prompt: Swap the items in slots 0 and 1 and return the array. [1, 2, 3] becomes [2, 1, 3].
hints: You need a temporary variable to hold one of them.

docs.name: list[i]
docs.what: The item at position i. Positions start at 0; -1 is the last item.

solution:
func solve(items):
	var temp = items[0]
	items[0] = items[1]
	items[1] = temp
	return items
